problem:
The volume of water in a tank was recorded over time for $25$ minutes, starting from time $t=0$ minutes. The following table shows the volume $V(t)$, in liters, recorded at time $t.$

| $t$ | $0$ | $5$ | $10$ | $15$ | $20$ | $25$ |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| $V(t)$ | $120$ | $150$ | $165$ | $180$ | $215$ | $240$ |

Approximate the rate of change of volume at time $t=5$ using a forward difference approximation. Do not round the answer.

At $t=5,$ the estimated rate of change is {{field-1}} liters per minute.

feedback.problem:
The total number of eggs laid by a pen of chickens on a farm is given by the function $e(t),$ where $t$ is the number of days since the chickens arrived on the farm. The values of $e(t)$ for different values of $t$ are given in the table below:

| $t$ | $1$ | $2$ | $3$ | $4$ | $5$ | $6$ |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| $e(t)$ | $20$ | $45$ | $77$ | $117$ | $160$ | $195$ |

Approximate the rate at which eggs are laid at the $4$th day using a forward difference approximation.
feedback.worked_solution:
We use the forward difference approximation

$$
{e}^{′}(t)≈\frac{e(t+h)-e(t)}{h}
$$

 
at the point $t=4.$ We choose the step size $h$ to be as small as possible, in this case $h=1.$ This gives

$$
\begin{aligned}{e}^{′}(4) & ≈\frac{e(4+1)-e(4)}{1} \\  & =\frac{e(5)-e(4)}{1} \\  & =\frac{160-117}{1} \\  & =\frac{43}{1} \\  & =43.\end{aligned}
$$

So at $t=4$ the rate at which eggs are laid is approximately $43$ eggs per day.
